definition.@DataWarehouse.sqlEditor.query:
SELECT
  b."BATCH_ID",
  CURRENT_UTCTIMESTAMP() AS "LOAD_TIMESTAMP",
  'S4_CURR'            AS "SOURCE_SYSTEM",
  o."SOURCE_FILE",
  "d"."ProjectInternalID","d"."ProjectExternalID","d"."Project","d"."ProjectDescription","d"."ProjectProfileCode","d"."CompanyCode","d"."ControllingArea","d"."FunctionalArea","d"."ProfitCenter","d"."ProjectObject","d"."PlannedStartDate","d"."PlannedEndDate","d"."WorkCenterLocation","d"."TaxJurisdiction","d"."ResponsiblePerson","d"."ResponsiblePersonName","d"."ApplicantCode","d"."ApplicantName","d"."CreatedByUser","d"."CreationDate","d"."LastChangedByUser","d"."LastChangeDate","d"."BasicDatesLastScheduledDate","d"."FcstdDatesLastScheduledDate","d"."FactoryCalendar","d"."SchedulingDurationUnit","d"."ForecastedStartDate","d"."ForecastedEndDate","d"."BusinessArea","d"."Plant","d"."Currency","d"."BudgetProfile","d"."PlanningProfile","d"."InvestmentProfile","d"."ProjInterestCalcProfile","d"."ResultAnalysisInternalID","d"."PartnerDeterminationProcedure","d"."ControllingObjectClass","d"."NetworkProfile","d"."WBSSchedulingProfile","d"."PlanningMethForProjBasicDate","d"."PlanningMethForProjFcstdDate","d"."NetworkAssignmentType","d"."WBSIsStatisticalWBSElement","d"."WBSIsMarkedForIntegratedPlng","d"."ProjectHasOwnStock","d"."InventorySpecialStockValnType","d"."WBSIsMarkedForAutomReqmtGrpg","d"."SalesOrganization","d"."DistributionChannel","d"."Language","d"."WBSElementMaskID","d"."Division","d"."DynItemProcessorPrfl","d"."StatusProfile","d"."WBSStatusProfile","d"."SimulationProfile","d"."SchedulingScenario","d"."DistributionProfile","d"."JointVenture","d"."JointVentureCostRecoveryCode","d"."JointVentureEquityType","d"."JointVentureObjectType","d"."JntIntrstBillgClass","d"."JntIntrstBillgSubClass","d"."FreeDefinedTableFieldSemantic","d"."FreeDefinedAttribute01","d"."FreeDefinedAttribute02","d"."FreeDefinedAttribute03","d"."FreeDefinedAttribute04","d"."FreeDefinedQuantity1","d"."FreeDefinedQuantity1Unit","d"."FreeDefinedQuantity2","d"."FreeDefinedQuantity2Unit","d"."FreeDefinedAmount1","d"."FreeDefinedAmount1Currency","d"."FreeDefinedAmount2","d"."FreeDefinedAmount2Currency","d"."FreeDefinedDate1","d"."FreeDefinedDate2","d"."FreeDefinedIndicator1","d"."FreeDefinedIndicator2","d"."StatusCombinationCode","d"."IsMarkedForDeletion","d"."Change_Type","d"."Change_Date"
FROM
"1_INBOUND_S4_CURR.1LT_I_PROJECTDATA_2_S4_CURR_Delta" d
CROSS JOIN "2SV_ACTIVE_BATCH_S4_CURR_01" b
JOIN "2LT_CTRL_LOAD_OBJECT_01" o
  ON o."BATCH_ID"      = b."BATCH_ID"
 AND o."SOURCE_SYSTEM" = 'S4_CURR'
 AND o."OBJECT_NAME"   = 'I_PROJECTDATA_2'
